data.one_liner: Handle environment variables safely using .env files and code generation.
data.what_it_does: Envify generates Dart classes containing constant expressions loaded from an environment (.env) file during compile time. This ensures type safety and makes variables available as constant expressions for other annotations.
use_when: You want compile-time safety and constant expressions for environment variables.
You want to avoid runtime asset loading and decoding overhead for config values.
avoid_when: You are starting a new project, as this package has been deprecated in favor of Envied.
strengths: Generates compile-time constant expressions for use in annotations and code generation.
Supports multiple environment files via annotations.
Casts values to literal types like int, double, num, bool, and String.
weaknesses: The package has been deprecated in favor of Envied and will not receive further updates.
data.setup_notes: Add envify and build_runner to dev_dependencies, create a .env file, and run build_runner.
